
[http://teddyb.org/robin/Lojban:+You're+Doing+It+Wrong obin's essay] contains a proposal that the BPFK should be guided by principles on what the purpose of the Lojban language is.

Ideally, we should have a document that is precise and unambiguous, and that everyone finds, if not perfect, then at least acceptable.

On this page, we outline a process for compiling such a document.

=== 1. Summarizing earlier statements of purpose, and arguments thereof ===

* [http://www.loglan.org/Loglan1/index.html oglan 1: A Logical Language]
* [http://mw.lojban.org/extensions/cll/ he Complete Lojban Language]

* [http://lojban.org/publications/level0/brochure/book1.html hat Is Lojban?]
* Mailing list discussions

** Elephant metaphor (Summary: Lojban is different to everyone, and thus has no single, unified goal)

=== 2. Writing up descriptions of contemporary goals ===

To the extent that they have not already been clearly described.

== Goals ==

'''NB''' hierarchical, but (as yet) unranked

* Usable by humans [http://mw.lojban.org/extensions/cll/1/1/ LL]
** Simple to learn [http://mw.lojban.org/extensions/cll/1/1/ LL]

* Computer-tractable [http://mw.lojban.org/extensions/cll/1/1/ LL] [http://www.loglan.org/Loglan1/chap1.html#sec1.4 1]
* Based on predicate logic [http://mw.lojban.org/extensions/cll/1/1/ LL] [http://www.loglan.org/Loglan1/chap1.html#sec1.2 1]

* Enable unambiguous expressions
** Have an unambiguous grammar [http://mw.lojban.org/extensions/cll/1/1/ LL]

** Audiovisual isomorphism
*** Phonetic spelling [http://mw.lojban.org/extensions/cll/1/1/ LL]

** Self-segregation (that a valid speech stream can only be segmented into words in one way) [http://mw.lojban.org/extensions/cll/1/1/ LL]
* No exceptions to the rules [http://mw.lojban.org/extensions/cll/1/1/ LL]

* Remove restrictions on creative and clear thought and communication [http://mw.lojban.org/extensions/cll/1/1/ LL]
* Be suitable for testing the Sapir–Whorf hypothesis [http://www.loglan.org/Loglan1/chap1.html#sec1. .1]

* “Metaphysical parsimony”, have as few obligatory categories as possible [http://www.loglan.org/Loglan1/chap1.html#sec1.3 1]
* Be suitable as an IAL [http://www.loglan.org/Loglan1/chap1.html#sec1.8 1]

* Be interesting and mentally stimulating [http://www.loglan.org/Loglan1/chap1.html#sec1.9 1]
* Cultural neutrality [http://mw.lojban.org/extensions/cll/1/1/ LL]
